blurb: Discover the Highlights, History and Scenic Views on this tour of Downtown Denver, Historic town of Golden, and Beautiful Lookout Mountain. Journey through the heart of the bustling streets of downtown Denver where historic landmarks like Union Station, Larimer Square and the State Capitol stand tall. Delve into the rich history of Golden, a charming town known for its quaint western vibe and proximity to the Rocky Mountains. Ascend the breathtaking heights of the Lariat Loop up Lookout Mountain, where panoramic vistas of the great plains and the Rocky Mountains will leave you awe-struck.
